text:
Chris Lee: Hey team, quick follow-up from the all-hands reliability section — dropping the RCA link and a few concrete asks so we can close the loop. :wave:
Eve (oncall): RCA here: https://redwood-inference.internal/rca/INC-2026-042 — root cause was a cache shard memory leak + a rollout that exercised a bad eviction path. Short summary in the doc.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 marked RESOLVED by Eve (oncall) at 2137799800.
Raj Patel: Thanks — two quick product questions: 1) Did this affect Dedicated customers or only hosted? 2) Any customer-facing notes we should push?
Eve (oncall): Only hosted API tier saw increased 5xx rate for ~7m during the spike. No Dedicated customers hit the flaky path. We're drafting a short post to customers, Raj — link below draft.
Sofia Gomez: Can you paste the minimal repro or the command you used to reproduce? I want to add it to the regression tests. :eyes:
Eve (oncall): Repro steps in the RCA, but core command used during debug: ```kubectl exec -it pod/cache-shard-0 -- /bin/sh -c 'while true; do dd if=/dev/zero bs=1M count=50 >> /mnt/cache/test; sleep 0.2; done'```
Maya R.: From infra side — suggested mitigation is to add a memory cap and OOM-kill guard on the cache process, plus an eviction sanity check. I can take the patch.
Chris Lee: Great. Let's convert suggestions into action items and owners. I want one PR for the patch + one for the canary rollout plan.
Maya R.: ACTION: Maya R. -> implement memory cap + eviction guard, open PR by 2137870000, tag @Ken Park for infra review.
Ken Park: ACK. I'll review and add a canary policy in the deployment controller.
Eve (oncall): ACTION: Eve -> coordinate canary and run smoke suite, ETA 2 days. Will post canary results in this thread.
Raj Patel: ACTION: Raj -> draft customer note and internal comms; will include impact window and mitigation summary. Draft: https://docs.redwood-inference.internal/comms/inc-2026-042-draft
Sofia Gomez: ACTION: Sofia -> add regression test to eval harness referencing repro steps, will include as part of the next test-run.
Chris Lee: Quick product/roadmap clarify: is this a one-off or does this change our priority for the cache rewrite we discussed in last quarter?
Maya R.: It's priority-upshift imo — patch first, but we should accelerate the cache rewrite planning. I'll add a roadmap ticket.
Eve (oncall): Also flag: the rollout that triggered this was a minor config tweak to eviction thresholds. Ops config validation will be a separate follow-up.
Chris Lee: OK — add that as an item.
Maya R.: New ticket created: https://redwood-inference.internal/infra/tickets/INF-946 — notes and owners included.
Ken Park: FYI I'll throttle automatic rollouts for cache-related services until we have both the guard and the canary policy in place.
ops-bot: Reminder: please update the RCA doc status and checkboxes: https://redwood-inference.internal/rca/INC-2026-042#actions
Chris Lee: One more ask to leads — please confirm owners and ETA in this thread by EOD tomorrow so I can close the all-hands follow-up list. :thumbsup:
Eve (oncall): Confirmed owners above; I'll post canary results and the smoke log snippet here.
Raj Patel: Confirmed on comms. Will ping Legal if we need a tailored customer outreach.
Sofia Gomez: Confirmed on tests.
Maya R.: Confirmed on patch + ticket linked.
Ken Park: Confirmed for infra review and temporary throttle.
Chris Lee: Thanks all. If anyone spots anything missing from the RCA or action list, reply here. We'll have a short sync tomorrow for any blockers. :clock1:
